_readme: Your product catalog. Edit prices and blurbs freely. For each product either paste a Stripe Payment Link into `paymentLink` (easiest — make them at dashboard.stripe.com/payment-links), or leave it null and the store will use the checkout function with STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.

products.name: Logo Maker
products.blurb: Drop a logo, strip the background, clean the edges, export a transparent PNG that's actually ready for DTF. No Photoshop, no subscription, no learning curve.

products.name: Gang Sheet Builder
products.blurb: Lay your art out on a 22" or 24" sheet, set how many and how big, and export a 300 DPI transparent file straight to your printer. Stop paying someone to gang your sheets.

products.name: Client Lockers
products.blurb: Give each client a private link. They upload their own logos, build their own shirts, and never see anybody else's work. You see all of it from one place.

products.name: OmniFlow Orders
products.blurb: Orders from Shopify, TikTok, eBay and your own forms land in one console — sorted, classified, and ready to pull. No more five tabs and a notebook.

products.name: All Access
products.blurb: The whole line — every tool we have now and every tool we add, branded to your shop. Nothing to pick, nothing locked. Stop whenever you want and you've lost nothing.
bullets: Your name and colors on all of it

products.name: The Whole Shop Kit
products.tagline: All of it, yours for good
products.blurb: Same everything as All Access, paid once. Four and a half months of the subscription and it's bought — this is the setup we run, handed to you.
